task: Owner decision 2026-11-04: restrict Velero UI to Keycloak group cluster-admin. POLICY_FILE_PATH was set but no file was mounted, so velero-ui 0.10.1 granted manage all to every authenticated user (guest included). Enforce with the app's own policy file, close the unguarded bulk download at the gateway, verify live, pin and document.

events.summary: Mechanism: velero-ui policy file via chart configuration.policies (ConfigMap at /policies/policies.csv) with the single line g,cluster-admin,manage,all, plus a gateway rule answering 403 for POST /api/backups/download. Gateway gatewayAdminOnly/R302 not applicable: the route uses app-native OAuth, no APISIX openid-connect. Deliberately left alone: /api/stats and /api/form/* (no policy check upstream), other apps, Keycloak clients.
Before the change every logged-in user had manage all; the running Deployment had POLICY_FILE_PATH but no policies volume, and the ConfigMap held only comments.

events.provenance: otwld/velero-ui tag v0.10.1 source read via gh api: casl-ability.factory.ts, auth.service.ts, oauth.strategy.ts, jwt-auth.guard.ts, controllers, chart templates; 2026-11-04
events.summary: Policy lines are g,<group>,<action>,<subject>; groups come from the userinfo claim named by OAUTH_GROUP_CLAIM; with no valid line the app falls back to u,*,manage,all; POST /api/backups/download, /api/stats and /api/form/* carry no CheckPolicies.

velero-ui.yaml enables configuration.policies; apisix-routes.yaml adds velero-ui-block-bulk-download; test-sso.sh gains velero_ui_token and a Velero UI cluster-admin block; R293 pins the exact policy, the gateway rule and the live-check shape; matrix and lessons-log updated.
First independent review done (Opus security review, see e9); corrections in e10. A re-review of the new head is pending (Narwhal merge gate).

events.scope: Local disposable cluster after push-to-gitea.sh with velero-ui and narwhal-platform Synced/Healthy; static suite. NOT covered: Kakao cluster, browsers, users beyond admin/dev/view/guest.
evidence: test:live: admin list 200, create 201 (real tiny backup, deleted via API, no leftovers), delete 200; view, dev, guest list/create/delete -> 403; bulk download 403 for all four; no session -> 401, root -> 302 /sso
test:RESEARCH_EVIDENCE_DIR=$(mktemp -d) make test -> exit 0 (an earlier run with 6 failures was a full disk)

events.provenance: Opus security review of PR #553 against otwld/velero-ui v0.10.1 source (app.config.ts, auth, controllers); 2026-11-04
events.summary: CRITICAL: JWT key falls back to the public default (AUTH_SECRET_PASSPHRASE unset). HIGH: bulk-download block bypassable via /download/ and /Download. MEDIUM: all auth providers off makes noAuthRequired() public. Unprotected and documented: /api/stats/*, /api/form/*, /api/settings/velero/server|ui, stub DELETE plugins, /api/config; CORS reflects any origin.

D-VELERO-UI-JWT-KEY: AUTH_SECRET_PASSPHRASE from secretKeyRef velero-ui-oauth/passphrase (velero-ui.yaml), generated once by 11-3 with openssl rand -base64 32 and kept on re-run; gateway rule is a case-insensitive regex with optional trailing slash; R293 pins both plus OAUTH_AUTH_ENABLED=true and BASIC_AUTH_ENABLED=false; matrix and lessons-log list the open endpoints. /api/form/secrets and config-maps are used by the admin storage-location credential forms, so they are documented, not blocked.

events.scope: Local disposable cluster after the secret block and push-to-gitea.sh; velero-ui and narwhal-platform Synced/Healthy. NOT covered: Kakao cluster, browsers.
evidence: test:live: HS256 JWT forged with the old public default key and manage-all permissions -> GET /api/backups HTTP 401
test:live: admin list 200, create 201 (tiny backup, then deleted via API, none left); view, dev, guest list/create/delete -> 403
test:live: POST /api/backups/download, /download/, /Download -> 403 for admin, view, dev and guest

events.summary: In the repository and on the local cluster, Velero UI policy-checked APIs allow only Keycloak group cluster-admin; other users get 403; bulk download is closed for everyone; unauthenticated users are still sent to login. Kakao and browsers not verified. OPEN: /api/stats and /api/form/* (including secret names) answer any logged-in user. Review follow-up: JWT key is now a generated secret and the download block covers the case and slash variants; the other unprotected endpoints are documented.

Complete for the cluster-admin restriction within repository and local-cluster scope. Follow-up (MEDIUM): /api/stats and /api/form/* have no upstream policy check; close at the gateway or upstream in a separate change.
